method.reference: One new PostgreSQL connection per example; search_path=pg_temp; schema creates temporary tables and independent temporary identity sequences; seed is loaded only into those tables.
method.live: Single SELECT/WITH examples replayed inside BEGIN READ ONLY against public tables.
method.comparison: Exact numeric comparison using Decimal; booleans normalized to 0/1; NULL preserved; column names compared; duplicate rows preserved; ordering checked when the registry marks ORDER BY.
method.html: SQL extracted from rendered pre blocks; displayed tables compared with registry; dialect-tab shared results resolved; cheatsheet previews limited to six rows as displayed.
method.expected_errors: Each expected failure also checked against its intended SQLSTATE.
method.scope: 193 registered PostgreSQL examples from units/*.html and docs/cheatsheet.html; excludes unregistered exercises, administrator commands and the separate root cheatsheet.html.
method.driver: Installed libpq 17.9 via Python ctypes; no additional dependency installed.
